note: Square-dance band recording of the 1954 Pat Ballard pop song Mr. Sandman; no traditional song of that title; Ballard d. 1960
Madriguera's recording of the Molinare song Chiu Chiu; the credit 'Nicanor Molinaro' is a misspelling of Molinare (d. 1957)

1948 Latin-dance 78 of El Cumbanchero; 'Morales' is bandleader/arranger Esy Morales (1916-1950), not a different composer; no other composed El Cumbanchero known, so this is Hernández's 1943 piece (d. 1965)
